pages.title: Aluminum
pages.text:
A light, fast metal for exploring.

- **Tier:** Iron
- **Durability:** 180
- **Sword damage:** 5.5
- **Armor (full set):** 12

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text: Smelt **Raw Bauxite** from **Bauxite Ore**, a reddish ore found between Y 32 and Y 96 everywhere, and in much richer deposits near the surface of **badlands** and **savannas** (Y 48 to 128). Mine it with a stone pickaxe or better.

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Fast weapons and tools:** very fast mining, and +0.3 attack speed on every tool, but low durability.
- **Light armor:** each piece adds 3%% movement speed (12%% for the full set), with a little less protection than iron.
- **Lightweight shield:** no slowdown while blocking (you still can't sprint).

pages.title: Featherweight
pages.text: **Full set bonus.** 50%% less fall damage, 5%% stronger jumps, and 33%% faster movement in water (like Depth Strider I).
A blast furnace works too, and is faster.
